componentSet.name: Menu
componentSet.description:
Menu — the floating panel. bg-floating + elevation-low (in dark mode the panel rises a ladder step instead of casting a shadow — the flashlight principle), rounded, with the BLEED GUARD: the block ends pad by the panel's own radius (same token) so full-bleed item fills never clip the corners; the sides stay unpadded — items run edge to edge. The items area is a true SLOT seeded with three Menu-items: designers add as many as they want. Positioning the panel is the consumer's job (popover + CSS anchor positioning). Also the collapsed sidebar's floating submenu.

Generated from eds.menu v0.3.0 — edit the contract, not this component.
